name: @visionhub/desktop
description: VisionHub Electron shell using the shared Web renderer

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @visionhub/web exec vite build --base=/ --outDir ../../apps/desktop/renderer-dist --emptyOutDir && node --check src/main.cjs && node --check src/preload.cjs && node --check src/security.cjs && node --check src/renderer-protocol.cjs && node --check src/application-menu.cjs && node --check src/window-state.cjs && node --check scripts/dev.mjs && node scripts/verify-renderer-build.mjs
